name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The output file output.mp3 is 43KB and verified as a valid MPEG ADTS layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural.
deviations: The quickstart's final step calls `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is headless with no audio output device, I replaced `play(audio)` with code that writes the audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`). The core API authentication and text-to-speech request matched the quickstart exactly.
